product.title: Large Airboat Swamp Tour with Transportation from New Orleans

description.text: Travel from downtown New Orleans by hotel pickup toward the swamp for a large-airboat ride on Louisiana waterways. After the drive along the Mississippi River corridor, board a 16-passenger airboat with a captain who narrates the route, explains local wildlife and flora, and balances faster runs with slower photo stops. Wildlife sightings vary by season and conditions, but the outing is designed around swamp scenery, alligator habitat, and a coordinated return transfer back to New Orleans.

highlights: Hotel pickup and drop-off from downtown New Orleans
Large 16-passenger airboat ride through swamp waterways
Captain narration about local wildlife and flora
Photo stops and seasonal alligator viewing opportunities

start.description: Pickup is available from selected downtown New Orleans hotels when confirmed at booking.

end.description: This activity returns to the selected New Orleans pickup location.
